name: Exploding Stove
disable: DC 20 Thievery check (trained) to disable the pressure sensors, or DC 20 Survival check (trained) to safely extinguish the stove fires

items.name: Explode
items.text:
Trigger A creature steps on the floor within 5 feet of the stove

---

Effect The stove explodes, dealing 2d10+13 fire to each creature within 10 feet (DC 20 basic Reflex save save).

text: The stove has been rigged to explode when pressure sensors under the floor are depressed.
